ns2:course.label: Life Drawing
ns2:course.description: Representational and interpretive drawing from life explored through close observation and structural analysis of the human figure and other subject matter. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: ARTF 102 and ARTF 104.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: ARTF 102 and ARTF 104.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Art majors only. Class Materials Fee of $20 required.
